summary.tldr: Temporarily doubles the GST/HST credit for six months, raising the maximum annual credit amounts for the 2022-2023 benefit year.
what_it_does: Amends the Income Tax Act to temporarily double the Goods and Services Tax/Harmonized Sales Tax (GST/HST) credit for six months.
Raises the maximum annual GST/HST credit amounts by 50% for the 2022-2023 benefit year.
who_it_affects: Tax filers eligible for the GST/HST credit
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 20 September 2022 and was given first reading.
